name: James Blair
current_role: Former White House Deputy Chief of Staff for Legislative, Political and Public Affairs (2025–2026); led Trump’s 2026 midterm political operation
summary: James Blair, the 2024 Trump campaign’s political director, became deputy chief of staff for legislative, political and public affairs in January 2025, one of Susie Wiles’s deputies, and kept the party’s narrow congressional majorities in line on Trump’s agenda. In April 2026 Trump sent him to run his midterm political operation, saying he would return afterward; the party lost both chambers in November.

source_conflicts.details: Trump said in April 2026 that Blair would return to the White House after the midterms (Axios). After the election, two sources told Reuters his return was unlikely (“He’s not coming back”), as relayed by Raw Story. Richard Walters was named to the deputy chief of staff post.
